text: {"name":"phy_set_config","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Associates a configuration with the indexed PHY context, applying it immediately or recording it for deferred application according to the radio state and context flags.","subsystem":"phy","var_renames":{"v4":"new_config","a2":"config_context","a3":"config_index","v6":"config_slot","v7":"current_context"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Per-index slot's associated context pointer."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Per-index slot's pending context pointer; the associated context's offset 4 is also updated with the new configuration pointer."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Per-index slot flag indicating a pending update."},{"offset":56,"meaning":"Configuration-context flags; bit 21 enables deferred configuration handling."}]}
